text: A reviewer left comments on your pull request in the analytics repository. Two files changed and one conversation is unresolved. Adjust your notification settings if you no longer wish to receive these updates.
Your monthly invoice is ready. Amount charged: 10.00 EUR to the card ending 4242. Your next billing date is 1 July. You can view past invoices or change your plan from workspace settings.
Reminder: sprint planning starts tomorrow at 10:00. The agenda is attached and the meeting notes from last week are in the shared drive. Please add any items you would like discussed.
Your package has been delivered to the collection point. Order number 84512. The pickup location is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00. Please bring photo identification.

This week in machine learning: three papers on multi-agent reinforcement learning worth your time, an interview on evaluation practice, and a short note on reproducibility. You can unsubscribe at any time.

You requested a password reset for your account. Use the code 481923 within ten minutes to continue. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this message and your password will remain unchanged.
You have three unread mentions from yesterday. The design channel discussed the onboarding flow and the data channel asked about the weekly export. Open the app to catch up.
The pipeline failed on the main branch. Job: integration tests. Two assertions failed in the payment module and the log output is available in the run summary. The previous run passed.
Your monthly statement is now available in the mobile application. It covers transactions from 1 May to 31 May. We never ask for your credentials by email; sign in through the app as usual.

You have been invited to review a submission for the workshop on emergent communication. The abstract is included below and the deadline for the review is 14 September. Please confirm whether you are available.

Congratulations, your wallet has been selected in our anniversary giveaway and credited with 0.5 ETH. Connect your wallet and confirm the recovery phrase to claim the reward before the offer expires tonight.

Your organisation password expires today. To keep your current password and avoid losing access to your mailbox, verify your account details now. Users who do not verify will be signed out of all devices.

Are you at your desk? I need you to process an urgent payment for a supplier before the end of the day, and I would prefer you keep this between us until the contract is announced. Reply as soon as you see this.
You have one new voicemail message waiting. Sign in with your email address and password to listen to the recording. Messages are removed from the server after 48 hours.
A colleague has shared a document with you titled Q3 salary review. Sign in with your work account to open the file. Access has been granted to your address only and will expire in three days.

Following our payroll system migration, please confirm your bank account details so that your next salary payment is not delayed. Complete the short form today; submissions after Friday will be processed next month.

Please note that our banking details have changed as of this month. Kindly update your records and remit the outstanding balance to the new account provided below. Payments to the old account can no longer be recovered.
Our records show that you are eligible for a tax refund of 284.50 EUR for the previous financial year. Submit your claim within five working days by confirming your identity and payment details.

Your annual subscription renews automatically today and 349.99 EUR will be charged to your saved payment method. If you did not authorise this renewal, cancel the transaction immediately using the details below.
Your mailbox storage is full and incoming messages are being rejected. Increase your quota now by confirming your credentials, otherwise your mailbox will be deactivated in 24 hours.
Vince, please review the attached spreadsheet for the gas desk forward curves and send your comments to the trading group before Friday's meeting. I have copied Louise on the revised assumptions.
Attached is the revised schedule for the hou office move. Please confirm with your group by the end of the week so that we can finalise the floor plan and the telephone list.
The conference on computational linguistics has extended the deadline for abstracts by two weeks. Submissions should follow the usual style sheet and be sent to the programme committee address.
Dear valued customer, your account has been temporarily suspended for security reasons. Click here to verify your billing information and restore full access to your online banking service.

I am writing to you in strict confidence regarding a transfer of twenty five million dollars from the account of a deceased client. I require a trustworthy foreign partner and offer you thirty percent of the total sum.
Congratulations, your email address was selected in our international lottery draw and you have won a cash prize. To claim your winnings, reply with your full name, address and telephone number.
